authority: Explicit author response in Codex chat
latest_author_direction: Prepare the command to launch the complete campaign before a long pause.
new_plan_review: A durable strict comparison to the complete previously accepted plan precedes any sbatch. All scientific/resource/environment/input fields must retain their canonical JSON values; only the reviewed technical source files, explicit recovery provenance and query/workspace metadata may change.
CI_gate: The single author-operated launch script waits for the exact source run to pass all five required jobs before creating the new stage. Failure or bounded wait expiry aborts without scheduler mutation.
execution_gate: HPC execution remains author CLI only. Claims are exclusive; partial or ambiguous submission is preserved for diagnosis, never retried automatically.
